additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / S0 170004177
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
Ltik0e
Problem Description
: Charger stuck in OperationMode: Init → Failure in MCCB closure
Troubleshooting
: This is the same problem we faced in Norway with the SiD400, there is an interference in the closing command signal of QA29.
My suggestion is to reboot the charger until it's working.
The new FW v6.1.3 has the fix, I requested R&D to support me in updating this charger since this is an experimental version I cannot do it by myself.
If you have anyone on-site we can do a simple cable change from the fuse and it will work. Let me know if this solution is the best for you at the moment and I can send you the changes that need to be performed.
For future reference, your case number is
0411084
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0411084-DC/Si-D/DE[Ltik0e] - OperationMode: Init CRM:00315002417
additional_info.body:
Hi Benjamin, good morning.
Yes, yesterday I was able to bring the charger back online but if there is any kind of reboot this issue might happen again.
R&D is requesting a full confirmation that you accept installing v6.1.3 to avoid this problem. In Norway we only installed a hotfix to confirm if they could deploy it in the next FW but it's the same thing.
Please confirm to me if you want it or not.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
